title: Say so when a color lets go of its style
goal: If you paint over a color that came from a named style, the link quietly breaks and nothing tells you. The app should say it happened, so nobody is surprised later when editing the style leaves that layer behind.
notes: Follow-up from queue/audits/2026-09-03-color-styles.json. PhotonzDocument.reconcileColorStyles already returns how many bindings broke and runs inside History.perform; the app throws that number away. The copies-followed pill (CopyConfirmation) is the shape to copy.
acceptance: Painting over a color that was using a style shows a short notice naming the style it let go of
The notice does not appear for an edit that did not break a link
Undo puts the link back with the color

log.note: folded into when-a-link-quietly-breaks-the-app-says-so-the-s, which covers the same notice for all four ways a link breaks rather than building it once for color and again for copies
